projects.description: A cozy productivity game built in MapleStory Worlds as part of the MSW Creator Program.
details: Project details and links will be updated here after the game has been published!

projects.name: SAD Game Engine
projects.description: A game engine created using C++ and ECS architecture.
details: Led a team of 12 to develop a game engine using C++ and ECS architecture.
Implemented advanced features such as lighting, scripting, and ray-casting, which significantly enhanced the gameplay experience.
C++ game engine showcased with a shooter-survival game.
ECS architecture for game objects and components.
Allows moving player-camera
Supports rendering of 3D models and materials.
Cel-shading for rendering.
CI/CD pipeline for automated testing.

projects.name: Illume
projects.description: A visually story rich game that follows the story of a girl and the future of the forest.
details: Made using Unity
Low poly art style.
Level design from moodboard to final implementation.
Storytelling and character development.

projects.name: Bian Beat
projects.description: Bian Beat is a rhythm game that's played with the expressions you make! Smile, frown, scowl, and pogface to the beat. Webcam required.
details: Developed the beatmap system to sync masks to the music.
Implemented game loop logic to handle the game state and transitions.
Worked on adding UI assets to the game to improve the user experience.

projects.name: HyperGOAP
projects.description: A simple open-world game created in UE5 showcasing procedural terrain generation and GOAP AI.
details: Developed procedural terrain generation using Markov Chain Models resulting in a dynamic open-world.
Implemented realistic tree objects and foliage placement techniques enhancing visual quality of the open-world.
Designed and integrated GOAP AI architecture for NPCs, allowing for a robust system for decision making.

projects.name: Focus Breakout
projects.description: A 3D adventure game where you play as a target orb trying to survive and escape the aim trainer simulation.
details: Set in a simulation of a target training game.
3 levels of varying difficulty.
Puzzle and obstacle solving.

projects.name: Octopations
projects.description: A Jackbox-style party game created for the Global Game Jam 2024.
details: Players take turns convincing the Hiring Manager (an octopus) that they are PERFECT for the job based on their past experiences.
A UI based party game create in UE5.
UI elements created using Unreal's UMG.
Gameplay mechanics created using Blueprints.

projects.name: Cownado
projects.description: An action-arcade game where you move cows to safety during a ridiculous storm. Created for the Brackeys Game Jam 2024.
details: A 2D action-arcade game created in Godot.
Gameplay mechanics created using GDScript.

projects.name: Hamstars
projects.description: Compete with up to 4 friends as a hamster in this fast-paced peanut hoarding brawl. Created during the Town One Game Jam, May 2022.
details: Winner of the Town One Artisan Award 🎨
Created using Unity
Hop in a hamster ball and squash the competition.
Collect and hoard peanuts before time runs out.

projects.name: mbajaman.dev
projects.description: This site - a React single-page portfolio with role-targeted views, deployed to GitHub Pages.
details: Built with React and react-router-dom, using a profile system to retarget the site per role.
Client-side routing on GitHub Pages via the spa-github-pages redirect pattern.
Separate staging and production deploy pipelines driven by npm scripts.

projects.name: Trial Date Calculator
projects.description: A tool to automate calendar invites/reminders for important deadlines leading up to the trial date.
details: In-house tool built using Sharepoint Online and Power Automate for a law firm.
Hosted on a local Flask server.
Automated hour long process of setting up calendar invites and Outlook tasks down to 5 minutes.

projects.name: Windows Image Deployment
projects.description: Streamlined and optimized the deployment of Windows images as part of the Harper Grey LLP equipment refresh process.
details: Reduced imaging time from 1 hour to 10 minutes.
Cleaned up and optimized package/software deployment process using PDQ.
Managed the deployment of over 200 computers and laptops at the firm.

projects.name: DMS Migration
projects.description: New document management system (DMS) end-user deployment for Harper Grey LLP.
details: Created Powershell scripts and PDQ packages to configure new DMS client for end-users to reduce manual work ensure minimum downtime.
Deployed to over 200 computers and laptops at the firm.
Trained and mentored end-users on how to use the new DMS system.

projects.name: Adobe Cloud Licensing
projects.description: Acquisition and deployment of Adobe Cloud Licensing for Harper Grey LLP.
details: Setup scripts and install packages to automate deployment for Adobe to end-users.
Handled license acquisition and allocation for 200+ users for a steady and controlled deployment process.

projects.name: NIDS
projects.description: A Network Intrusion Detection System created using Python and machine learning.
details: Researched and added code for Sequential Feature Selection.
Added K-Neighbors Classifier as one of the classification models.
Worked on solving the factorization issue on trained models.
Labelling task for malicious packets achieved f1-score of 99% accuracy while attack category classification achieved 55% accuracy.

projects.name: Sentiment Analysis
projects.description: A sentiment analysis tool created using Python and trained on the YELP dataset.
details: Implemented a Naive Bayes model and reviewed its relevant literature.
Tuned and tested RoBERTa model.
Added pre-processing steps to the dataset to improve model performance.
